content.content: 1. Necessity: the count rule needs the grammar for invocation shape — without a verb notion, exactly-one-verb is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Count is where the elaboration meets the grammar; the gate keeps the use sound without testing arity itself.
